scenarios.name: Free shipping from €50
scenarios.reason: Checkpoint assertion failed: "shipping is €4.90 and the total is €49.40."
scenarios.diagnosis: The bag calculated shipping as free before the order reached the required free-shipping amount, so the displayed total was too low.
scenarios.suggestion: Fix the shipping threshold calculation so a €44.50 bag is charged €4.90, then verify that adding one Paper Filters item makes shipping free and the total €51.00.
